faults.title: Driver-assist software recall (Mk4)
faults.description: In August 2022, over 15,000 Mk4 Jazz hybrids built January 2020 to January 2021 were recalled because faulty software could stop some driver-assistance systems working properly. New software fixes it.

faults.title: Takata airbag recalls (Mk1 and Mk2)
faults.description: Auto Express says the Mk1 and Mk2 Jazz had 14 recalls between them, many linked to faulty Takata airbags that could injure occupants in a crash. Check the work has been done on older cars.

faults.title: Minor infotainment and air-con electrical faults (2020-on)
faults.description: What Car? says the 2020-on Jazz is very reliable, but some owners in its reliability survey reported minor electrical problems with the infotainment and air-conditioning.
